history.period: Modern local temple; founding date undocumented
history.summary: Generic CSV name ('Hanuman Mandir, Siwan') has no single documented referent: Siwan has at least eight small Hanuman temples (Habibnagar, bus stand/Lalit, Kagzi Muhalla, Manjha, Andar, Dudhra, Naya Bazar, Halim Tola). This file documents the most-listed one, Hanuman Mandir at Shukla Toli, Habibnagar (JustDial 4.6, 215 ratings; reviewers note a tall single-stone Hanuman statue and location behind Krishna cinema). No published history, dynasty, or founder is recorded; opening hours conflict between listings (JustDial 6:00 AM-12:00 PM; Yappe bus-stand listing 4:30 AM-8:45 PM). Identity ambiguous — flag before publishing as 'the' Hanuman Mandir of Siwan. Coordinates are Siwan town-level approximations, not the temple POI.

name: Hanuman Mandir (Shukla Toli, Habibnagar)
town_description: Siwan is a city and district headquarters in northwestern Bihar on the Saran–Gopalganj corridor, with a busy junction (Siwan Junction) on the Chhapra–Gorakhpur rail line. Nearby attractions include the Mahendranath Shiva temple at Mehdar and the Dakshina Kali shrine at Darauli.

travel.airport: Jayprakash Narayan International Airport, Patna (~140 km)
travel.road: Siwan town; nearest bus stand at Lalit (~0.1 km per Yappe)
